scope: BWM launch with explicit physical GPU ID
summary: Accelerate rejected one gpu_id because its inherited distributed type was still MULTI_GPU.
evidence: Accelerate returned ValueError: Less than two GPU ids were configured and tried to run on multiple GPUs.
lessons: Explicit gpu_ids must be paired with an experiment-owned distributed_type NO configuration.
limitations: The training script did not start and produced no checkpoint.
next_actions: Write and pass an immutable single-GPU Accelerate config per experiment.
